content.description: Stampd.io allows minting NFT tokens on the Cardano blockchain. It also provides a service of implementing the NFT token on an NFC tag to link the NFT with physical objects. NFT minting on the Cardano blockchain. Use the public blockchains to timestamp your files with indelible proof. Create non-fungible tokens (NFT) in Cardano. It provides feedback on whether a SHA256 hash has been stamped on the selected blockcha through stampd.io and whether the pertinent transaction has been included in a block with the appropriate confirmations.
